title: Staff accounts must enter a code from an authenticator app before they can open admin or pass a staff gate

source.ref: Owner ruling 2026-11-26 (project thread: Restore password login alongside magic link and Google): Required for admins

detail: FOUND 2026-11-26: after SEC-045 a staff account could open /admin with a password alone; auth.mfa_factors was empty (no one had a second factor). Live 2026-11-26: 1 platform staff account (web_role admin/janitor) and 3 team_members. SHIPPED: lib/auth/mfa.ts requireStaffAal2 reads aal from verified claims and sends a staff caller without aal2 to /sign-in?step=mfa (or step=mfa-setup); wired into requireAdmin (staff callers only, so community hosts are never asked), requireAdminFloor, requireStaff, requireStaffCap and requireJanitor (throws); proxy.ts returns 403 to a server-action POST under /admin without aal2. Steps of the one /sign-in page: enter a code, or scan a QR and prove the first code (stale half-done setups cleared). Tries limited per account (mfa:verify, 6 per 10 minutes, fail open like LIVE-043) on top of Supabase. Settings > Account shows staff the status and a reset that needs aal2. Break glass ADMIN_MFA_BYPASS (envFlag, blank in .env.example) and the lost-phone procedure in docs/RUNBOOKS.md, Two-step codes for staff. ADR-1980.

verify.note: Fails while any staff guard skips the step-up, the proxy lets an admin action run without aal2, the code or setup step is not wired to Supabase verify, code tries are unthrottled, or break glass and the runbook are missing.
